node_definition.done_when: Since every-signal-caller-names-its-run-directory, each caller pre-writes an attribution record and _signal_process_group then has signal_worker write a second attribution before signalling, so every delivered signal leaves two attribution lines and one outcome. recovery.unwatch passes no run_dir, so its signal records no outcome, and it names its project through outcome_detail, which is the outcome's field. After this node, a delivered signal leaves one attribution and one delivered outcome, a refused one leaves one refused record, and unwatch records its outcome in the watch directory with the project in a field of its own. The landing record states which writer owns the attribution. tests/test_unwatch_leaves_a_sender_record.py and tests/test_every_signal_caller_names_its_run_directory.py assert the exact record count and outcome for a delivered and a refused signal on the unwatch path and on one caller from each of dispatch.py, promotion.py and recovery.py. The declared negative control is executed and logged. Base and head arms of tests/test_every_signal_leaves_a_sender_record.py, tests/test_every_signal_caller_names_its_run_directory.py, tests/test_unwatch_leaves_a_sender_record.py, tests/test_worker_signal_reach.py and tests/test_promotion_release.py show zero added failures.
